title: Compass POST /ask — the PA's answer, as the sidecar's POST /ask passes it to the panel (v1)
description: U16W (tellefsen-compass-mcp main, merged as #18 on 2026-10-05; docs/ask.md): the PA answers a question about a run, a town, a client or a milestone from the substrate; every ask is a governed run of its own on the Worker (ES-4.6). The top level is the 200 body; $defs.error is every other status's body. The sidecar (server/harnesses/compass/ask.mjs) keeps these keys and nothing else, so additionalProperties is false: a key the Worker adds stays on the Worker until this schema names it. The sidecar checks values as well as keys against this file (every type, enum, pattern and minimum): a value that does not fit is dropped when optional, nulled when the schema allows null, and otherwise the whole answer is refused as bad_answer. Every string has the bearer's value cut out. By place, never by person: no key here is a person.

answer.description: The answer, ending with a 'Based on' line the Worker writes from what it read — or, on a refusal, the plain Annex III refusal text.

based_on.description: What the answer rests on, as data. read false means named, not read (with a note).

label.description: What a person reads in the Based on line

run_id.description: The ask's own governed run (skill agent-world-pa, or zztest-agent-world-pa about a test place) — not the run asked about.

model.description: The id the vendor says served the call; null when no model was called (a refusal by the question check). An id, never a sentence: letters, digits and . _ : / @ - only.

provider.description: The vendor that served the call (a pattern, not an enum: the fork names no model vendor as a quoted string — invariants.test.mjs); null when no model was called.

usage.description: The vendor's count in the firm's shape (input_tokens excludes the cache); null when none was reported or no model was called.

tokens_in.description: input + cache writes + cache reads (U16W's name)

truncated.description: The substrate was cut to fit, or the answer hit the output limit.

ledger.description: Whether the ask's run was recorded. A 200 with run_completed false is still an answer.

refused.description: A refusal: Annex III or English only, by the question check, the model, or the answer check — or the world's own backstop (reason named_person).

reason.description: annex_iii: the PA does not judge people. english_only: the Worker's checks read English only, so a question (or an answer) that is not plainly English is refused (compass-ask, 2026-10-05). named_person: the world's own backstop — the answer named someone the ledger scan names, so the sidecar withheld it (ADR-0008); the Worker never sends it.

withheld.description: The answer was withheld (by the Worker's answer check, or by the world's named_person backstop); answer is a plain refusal, never the model's text.

error.description: Every status but 200: the Worker's {error, detail?} — 400 a sentence naming the field · 401 unauthorized · 405 method not allowed · 413 body exceeds 8192 bytes · 429 ask_budget_exceeded (retry_after from the Retry-After header) · 502 budget_unavailable / ledger_unavailable / substrate_unavailable / provider_failed / provider_timeout / out_of_time · 503 ask_not_configured — or the sidecar's own: 403 (not Owner), 409 ask_in_flight, 415, 502 worker_unreachable / bad_answer, 503 world_not_configured, 504 worker_timeout. An error with no code of its own reads http_<status>.
